description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named LeaveWithDaysLeft used within the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin to encapsulate leave information along with days left details. It includes properties such as leave ID, date, duration (hours and days), status, leave type ID, employee number, and days left, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: LeaveWithDaysLeft
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a leave record with associated days left, including properties like leave ID, date, duration, status, leave type, employee number, and days remaining.
